distribution.narrative: Smith et al. (2020) records Yunnan and Taiwan. Beaver & Liu (2010) independently supports Taiwan; current distribution remains Yunnan and Taiwan.

host_note: No confirmed host is promoted. Beaver & Liu (2010) reports the host as unknown.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Cnestus testudo (Eggers, 1939).

taxonomic_history.name: Cnestus testudo
taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: Current accepted identity is Cnestus testudo (Eggers, 1939), VSN_1137. Beaver & Liu (2010) preserves the placement in Cnestus and notes the transfer from Xylosandrus to Cnestus by Dole & Cognato (2010).
